title: SB456 (2022 Regular): Firearms - Handgun Qualification License - Firearms Orientation Component

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Maryland) (gun-policy Stage 5, Maryland); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Maryland text (First Reader; official copy, https://mgaleg.maryland.gov/2022RS/bills/sb/sb0456f.pdf)
provenance.note: First reader, as filed; no vote recorded. Quote skips unchanged intervening items (course hours, classroom topics, background investigation), which are only renumbered.

operative_text: Section 1 (Md. Code Ann., Public Safety § 5–117.1(d)): (d) (1) Subject to subsections (f) and (g) of this section, the Secretary shall issue a handgun qualification license to a person who the Secretary finds: (I) is at least 21 years old; (II) is a resident of the State; 3. a firearms orientation component that: A. demonstrates the person’s safe operation and handling of a firearm; and B. MAY INCLUDE THE USE OF LIVE OR INERT AMMUNITION; (2) A PERSON MAY NOT BE REQUIRED TO FIRE ROUNDS OF LIVE AMMUNITION AS PART OF THE FIREARMS ORIENTATION COMPONENT UNDER PARAGRAPH (1)(III)3 OF THIS SUBSECTION.
